name: 📬 Inbox Agent
description: Email in → classified → replies drafted → you approve → sent. A schedule trigger and a workflow that uses whatever mail tool the agent has (Gmail from the Tools Hub, or any MCP mail server). Nothing leaves without your yes.

commands.name: setup
commands.desc: Install the inbox workflow and check the mailbox on a schedule (default every 30 min, the Director)

library.for: support · sales · anyone drowning in mail
library.needs: a mail tool granted to the agent in the Tools Hub (e.g. Gmail)
